name: ULID Generator
summary: Generate sortable ULIDs with millisecond timestamps and secure randomness.
description: Create lexicographically sortable 26-character ULIDs. Optionally set a custom Unix millisecond timestamp. Batch mode increments time by 1 ms per ID for ordered lists.

faqs.question: What is a ULID?
faqs.answer: A Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier — 48 bits of timestamp plus 80 bits of randomness, encoded in Crockford Base32.

faqs.question: Why are batch ULIDs sortable?
faqs.answer: Each generated ID in a batch uses a timestamp one millisecond later than the previous, preserving sort order.

faqs.question: Can I decode the timestamp?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool shows the ISO time decoded from the first ULID in the list.
